# Experimentation Details Re-design Sync
Date: 2026-09-23 | Duration: 56.70000076293945m

## Summary
The discussion covered improvements to analysis plans, approval flows, experiment editing, navigation, and release planning. Scheduling placement remained unclear, with possible ties to the start process, decision-making, and power analysis. The team questioned how conditional and advanced options should be exposed and proposed simplifying analysis-plan changes by hiding unused fields and showing key experiment details. Approval flows were to be rewritten for a cohesive experience, with call outs remaining the primary indicator for pending requests; comments would remain secondary and would not change approval state. A full-screen review surface was preferred over modals because of scrolling concerns, while multi-approver and stale-approval cases required attention. UI discussions addressed inline versus modal editing, rich text in experiment setup, traffic split diagrams, drag-and-drop metadata ordering, inline editing for linked feature flags, and JSON editing in a modal. Navigation topics included the Review Changes button, avoiding layout shifts, and whether a sidebar should collapse on the results tab. The team targeted an 80% solution for broad release, emphasized P0 priorities, noted uncertainty around QA resources, and accepted iterative improvements after launch.

## Keywords
Experiment redesign, Approval flows, Analysis plan, Inline editing, UI layout, Change requests
